subject: general
question: Which of the following was added to the list of official languages of India in 1967?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sindhi__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Sindhi language** was added to the list of languages in the Indian Constitution by the **21st Amendment in 1967.**
 
• It was added to the **8th schedule by the 21st Amendment Act of 1967.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are **22 languages** that have been recognized in the **eighth schedule of the Indian constitution**.
 
• **Part XVII** of the Indian constitution deals with the official languages of India from **articles 343 to 351.**
 
• **Originally, only 14 languages** were mentioned and later, after several amendments, the other languages were added. 
 
• The Sindhi language was added to the 8th schedule by the** 21st Amendment Act of 1967.**
 
• **Konkani, Manipuri and Nepali** were added by the **71st Amendment Act of 1992.**
 
• **Bodo, Dongri, Maithili and Santhali** were added by the **92nd Amendment Act of 2003.**
 
• Of all the** 22 official languages the Hindi language is spoken by most of Indians.**
